snippet.title: 【HYKE: Northern Light(s)】Free Update “A Witch’s Chill Time” Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
HYKE: Northern Light(s) – Free Update “A Witch’s Chill Time” Arrives April 30!
HYKE: Northern Light(s) is now available on Nintendo Switch™, Steam®, PlayStation®5, and Apple Arcade.
※ The free update for Apple Arcade will be released at a later date.

⚠ This content contains spoilers for the main game. ⚠

◆STORY – “A Witch’s Chill Time”
After joining forces with their companions to defeat the Wiseman, Hyke and her allies are finally reunited with Aurora.
With the fierce battles behind them, a period of calm begins to settle in.

One day, guided by Aurora’s invitation, Hyke and the others step into a mysterious space.
What they find there is—unexpectedly—a hot spring.

However, Aurora explains that during the creation of this space, she lost the items needed to fully enjoy it.
To recover the missing tools, Hyke and her companions set out to explore the area.

A brand-new adventure begins as they work together to create their ideal hot spring.

◆STORE PAGES
My Nintendo Store: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hyke-northern-light-s-switch/
Steam®: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680380/
PlayStation® Store:https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009771/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hyke-northern-light-s/id6479881755

◆STAFF
Planning・Produce：AKATSUKI GAMES
Development：BLAST EDGE GAMES
Character Designer：orie
Producer：Hiroaki Iwano
Dot art Design：Setamo/Shiros
The theme song：“Silhouette feat. Isekaijoucho”
Publish：AKATSUKI GAMES、Aniplex

◆SPEC
Title: HYKE: Northern Light(s)
Release:Now Available
Genre:2D Top-Down Action RPG
Languages:Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese
